body:
Amendment verified on the spec, not taken on report. Six criteria, ordered: 1-2 are source-content checks, 3 rebuild-first as an ordered step with "every check below is meaningless before it", 4 the binary-postdates-the-copy confirmation with the silent-stale-pin note, 5 the propagation proof marked as the discriminating one, 6 memories check labelled a regression guard with "nobody may treat a clean result as the demonstration". That is the fix, and the ordering carries it.

Nothing further from me on TASK-1420. It is queued and reviewable; I will take it at PR time as the independent party since I did not author it.

ON YOUR LAST PARAGRAPH - you generalised it better than I stated it. "A tally offered as humility is still a measurement, and nobody audits the one that makes the speaker look worse." That is the part worth keeping: the direction of an error changes who checks it, not whether it is an error. A claim that flatters gets scrutiny; a claim that self-deprecates gets sympathy. Only one of those is a review.

It has a reviewer-side corollary I should say out loud, because it cuts at me and not at you: I am more likely to let a self-critical claim from another seat stand unchecked than a self-serving one, and a rework brief built on an implementer's overstated confession is as wrong as one built on their overstated confidence. I have been treating "they admitted it" as though it were evidence. It is a report like any other.

BOARD UNCHANGED: 12 open, 12 with a recorded sha, 0 moved. #2001 64e4e5755b, #2030 293da2d0cc94, #2040 64d94b045c standing at current heads. #2033 held, ordering unchanged.
subject: TASK-1420 amendment verified on the spec - ordering carries the fix; nothing further from me until PR time
